name: cinema
description: A complete local AI filmmaking Web App packaged with its own Cinema runtime.

shortDescription.en-US: A complete local AI filmmaking App with Canvas, Edit, and Deliver workspaces.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 包含画布、剪辑与交付工作台的完整本地 AI 影视应用。

longDescription.en-US: Install and run the complete anybox for cinema Web App from the Right Sidebar. The plugin owns its Web build, local HTTP Runtime, project data, providers, credentials, media toolchain, migrations, and MCP tools.
longDescription.zh-CN: 从右侧栏安装并运行完整的 anybox for cinema Web App。插件独立拥有 Web、HTTP Runtime、项目数据、Provider、凭据、媒体工具链、迁移与 MCP 工具。

defaultPrompt: Initialize this folder as an anybox for cinema project
Prepare a local cinema project structure
Create a storyboard with Text and Image nodes

platformArtifacts.description: Cinema native helper for the operating-system keychain and user-initiated file or directory selection.

network.description: User-configured ComfyUI image and video generation endpoint.

installReview: Runs the Cinema Web/API Runtime locally and stores only Cinema-owned state beneath the App Runtime data, cache, and log directories.
Installs a platform-specific native helper after SHA-256 verification for system-keychain access and user-initiated file or directory selection.
Stores provider secrets only in the operating-system keychain; when unavailable, credentials may be used for this Runtime process only and are never written to disk.
Connects to the disclosed Kling, Google, FFmpeg release, and user-configured OpenAI-compatible or ComfyUI origins.
Downloads the pinned FFmpeg toolchain only after the user starts installation; verifies archive and internal file SHA-256 values before atomic activation. FFmpeg is not included in the plugin ZIP.

mcpServers.name: anybox for cinema
mcpServers.description: Read and update local anybox for cinema projects using only Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas nodes. Interactive generation runs through the plugin App Runtime.
permissions: Reads Cinema project metadata, canvas state, and recent events from local project folders.
Creates and updates Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas nodes, valid edges, and viewport state after approval.
Writes Cinema canvas state to .anybox-cinema/canvas.json and command events to .anybox-cinema/events.jsonl.
Uses the same Cinema contracts, revision checks, idempotency records, and project lease locks as the Web Runtime.

tools.name: cinema_get_project_summary
tools.title: Get Cinema Project Summary
tools.description: Read an initialized Cinema project's local summary, node counts, recent events, directory overview, and gaps.

tools.name: cinema_apply_command
tools.title: Apply Cinema Command
tools.description: Apply a validated four-node Cinema canvas command directly to local .anybox-cinema/canvas.json.

tools.name: cinema_create_storyboard
tools.title: Create Cinema Storyboard
tools.description: Create storyboard Text nodes with optional connected Image nodes on the Cinema canvas.

installReview: Runs the local Bun MCP server bundled and built with the Cinema plugin.
Reads and writes an explicitly supplied initialized Cinema project through the plugin's shared storage layer.
Accepts only Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas node types.
The MCP and interactive App Runtime share the same contracts, revisions, idempotency records, and cross-process lease locks.
Canvas write actions are configured to ask before execution.

skillPreviews.name: Initialize Cinema Project
skillPreviews.description: Initialize a project through the Cinema Runtime, inspect it, and seed a storyboard with the bundled MCP tools.
